answers.answer: The supplied evidence does not contain Section 01100 paragraph 1.04, any scheduled construction time for three sequential work areas, or a one-floor-at-a-time constraint. The only references to Section 01100 found are a table of contents line, paragraph 1.03 regarding the Anticipated Jobsite Start Date and Notice to Proceed, and general sign and working-hours text. No arithmetic for total scheduled construction time can be performed from this evidence.

The evidence does not state a 589-day contract duration, a 367-day on-site duration, or any Section 01100 paragraph 1.03 text containing those numbers. The only reference to Section 01100 paragraph 1.03 concerns a 180-day notice-to-proceed period, not contract or on-site duration, so the requested difference cannot be established or calculated from the supplied evidence.

Section 00800 states $2000.00 per calendar day for failure to complete the work on time and states punch-list delay liquidated damages as 10 percent per calendar day and closing-document delay liquidated damages as 5 percent per calendar day. The requested per-day dollar amounts for 10 percent and 5 percent cannot be established because the evidence does not contain a quoted calculation applying those percentages to $2000.00; computing the products would require arithmetic not present in the evidence.
